function.name: get_dispute
function.description:
Get details for a specific dispute from PayPal.

This tool is used to lists disputes with a summary set of details, which shows the dispute_id, reason, status, dispute_state, dispute_life_cycle_stage, dispute_channel, dispute_amount, create_time and update_time fields.

dispute_id.description: The order id generated during create call
dispute_id.title: Dispute Id

function.name: get_order_details
function.description:
Use this tool to retrieve the current status of a PayPal order.

Paramters:
- order_id (str, required): The PayPal order ID you want to check.

function.name: get_payout_item
function.description: Read a PayPal payout item by its resource ID; cannot cancel or send a payout.

function.name: get_shipment_tracking
function.description:
Get tracking information for a shipment by ID.
This function retrieves tracking information for a specific shipment using the transaction ID and tracking number.
The transaction_id can fetch from the captured payment details in the order information.
Below is the payload request structure:

order_id.description: The ID of the order for which to create a shipment.
order_id.title: Order Id

transaction_id.description: The transaction ID associated with the shipment tracking to retrieve.
transaction_id.title: Transaction Id

function.name: list_disputes
function.description:
List disputes from PayPal.

This function retrieves a list of disputes with optional pagination and filtering parameters.

disputed_transaction_id.description: Filters the disputes in the response by a transaction, by ID.
disputed_transaction_id.title: Disputed Transaction Id

function.name: list_transactions
function.description:
List transactions from PayPal.

This tool is used to list transactions with optional filtering parameters within a date range of 31 days. This tool can also be used to list details of a transaction given the transaction ID.

- The start_date and end_date should be specified in ISO8601 date and time format. Example dates: 1996-12-19T16:39:57-08:00, 1985-04-12T23:20:50.52Z, 1990-12-31T23:59:60Z
- The transaction_status accepts the following 4 values:
    1. "D" - represents denied transactions.
    2. "P" - represents pending transactions.
    3. "S" - represents successful transactions.
    4. "V" - represents transactions that were reversed.
- The transaction_id is the unique identifier for the transaction.

transaction_id.description: The ID of the transaction to retrieve.
transaction_id.title: Transaction Id

transaction_status.description: Transaction status: D, P, S, or V
transaction_status.title: Transaction Status

start_date.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a start date and time, in ISO8601 format. Seconds required; fractional seconds optional.
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: Filters the transactions in the response by an end date and time, in ISO8601 format. Maximum range is 31 days.
end_date.title: End Date

search_months.description: Number of months to search back for a transaction by ID. Default is 12 months.
search_months.title: Search Months

function.name: query_money_graph
function.description: Read related masked dashboard facts using a fixed query name and internal UUID. cash needs no id; other queries require id. No SQL or URLs are accepted.

function.name: simulate
function.description: Ask the read-only what-if simulator about a payout run. An unavailable result means no prediction was made; simulation never executes a payout or changes reserves.
